headline: Gold Plunges to Over One-Year Low Amid Tech Selloff and Inflation Fears
summary: Gold futures closed sharply lower, hitting a one-year low amid a broader selloff in technology stocks driven by concerns over artificial intelligence spending and renewed inflation fears.
why: Precious metals prices react to shifting macroeconomic sentiment, inflation expectations, and liquidity adjustments across global asset classes.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Broad market liquidations and inflation fears drive down spot and futures gold prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A general risk-off rotation and broad liquidations across asset classes driven by tech sector concerns and inflation worries triggered heavy selling in precious metals.
